visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide eye-level shot from an airplane window, showing a white wing over a vast green forest canopy under a bright, clear blue sky. A digital map animation follows, highlighting a flight path from Taipei to South America. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a green and yellow Brazilian flag waving vigorously against a sunny sky, followed by a bright orange layered cocktail on a table. Finally, the Christ the Redeemer statue is shown standing as a tall silhouette through thick, swirling white fog. (2) The scene transitions to a sunlit airport tarmac with a white and blue airplane. High-angle drone-style footage from a helicopter captures the expansive Iguazu Falls with white water crashing over rocky cliffs. The main character, a woman with long black hair wearing a black outfit, smiles while stepping out of a white helicopter. She is then seen walking on a wooden boardwalk near the falls and eventually on a boat, wearing an orange life vest and a white hood, screaming in excitement as the boat drives into the heavy mist of the waterfall. (3) The vlog moves to Argentina, showing the blue and white flag waving. Top-down shots reveal the massive 'Garganta del Diablo' with powerful white rapids. In Buenos Aires, the camera tours the grand interior of the El Ateneo bookstore, featuring ornate ceiling paintings and golden balconies. The woman is seen in a classic wood-paneled cafe eating golden-brown churros and walking through the vibrant, colorful streets of La Boca. A tango performance is shown on a dark stage with a male and female dancer in elegant attire performing complex footwork. (4) A travel sequence shows a flight to Ushuaia with views of jagged, snow-covered mountains from above. The woman walks past a large white 'Ushuaia' sign by the cold blue water. She is seen mailing postcards and visiting a historical prison with stone walls. A green tourist train travels through a sparse, wintry forest. The scene then shifts to the Perito Moreno Glacier, showcasing towering walls of brilliant blue ice. The woman is seen dancing a joyful partner dance with an older man in a rustic wooden building near the border. (5) In Santiago, Chile, a red cable car rises over a sprawling urban landscape. The scene moves to Brasilia, showing the modern, white Cathedral of Brasilia and the National Congress building under a bright sun. The woman, wearing a white shirt, cycles down a wide, empty city street at 6:00 AM. The background features flat urban topography and minimalist modern architecture. (6) The final phase highlights the Amazon rainforest. The woman travels by a small wooden boat on a brown river, fishes for piranhas, and holds a small caiman at night with guides. A red-faced monkey is seen in the trees. She swims with a pink river dolphin and visits an indigenous tribe in a thatched-roof hut. The video concludes in Sao Paulo, showing the red pillars of the MASP museum, a grand stone cathedral, and a football stadium before the final flight back to Taiwan at night.
